about: Essa Township is a rural municipality in Simcoe County, Ontario, southwest of Barrie. Angus is the main settlement; other hamlets and farmland surround Canadian Forces Base Borden, which sits partly within and beside the township. It is countryside and villages, not a city. About 23,000 people live in Essa Township.
